input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to a tab-separated primer samplesheet, a primer FASTA, or a directory of primer FASTA files. Alternative to --primer_set (mutually exclusive) - required unless --primer_set or --build_references is given.
input.help_text: Provide a TSV samplesheet with primer, fwd, rev, min and max columns, a single .fa/.fasta/.fna primer FASTA, or a directory containing them. A file is read as FASTA or samplesheet based on its first non-blank line, not its extension. FASTA input requires --primer_min and --primer_max.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

teeliste.description: Target-taxa TSV used by the interactive Tea List and Primer Evaluation pages

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

build_references.description: Alternative workflow to install the references

install_taxdump.description: Install both the NCBI taxonomy dump and nucl_gb.accession2taxid during --build_references

install_core_nt.description: Install the NCBI core_nt BLAST database during --build_references

primer_min.description: Global minimum amplicon length for --input primer FASTA input

primer_max.description: Global maximum amplicon length for --input primer FASTA input

dbs.description: A comma-separated list of pre-installed databases to benchmark against

taxid.description: Restrict --dbs/--custom_db to this taxid (and its descendants) before analysis, so only that taxon is analysed/checked

analysis_taxids.description: Taxids (numbers only), comma-separated, e.g. 4442,4441, or a .txt file with one taxid per line

coverage_identity.description: Coverage analysis: minimum % identity of a centroid hit on an analysis taxid record

coverage_query_cov.description: Coverage analysis: minimum % of the centroid that one hit must cover

taxonomic_coverage_blast.description: Search core_nt for centroid hits within the configured taxid

taxonomic_coverage_taxid.description: NCBI taxid used to restrict the core_nt centroid search, including descendants

core_nt_db.description: Path to the core_nt BLAST database prefix; overrides the database under --reference_base

taxonomic_coverage_identity.description: Taxonomic coverage BLAST: minimum % identity of a centroid hit on a database record

taxonomic_coverage_query_cov.description: Taxonomic coverage BLAST: minimum % of the centroid that one hit must cover

primer_set.description: A comma-separated list of named primer sets (from the bio-raum/FooDMe2 catalog) to use instead of --input

list_primers.description: List available primer sets (as JSON) and exit

reference_base.description: The base folder to which the references have been installed

taxdump.description: Path to a pre-installed NCBI taxdump directory. Overrides the default derived from --reference_base/--reference_version.

accession_taxonomy.description: Path to an accession2taxid/genbank2taxid mapping file. Overrides the default derived from --reference_base/--reference_version.

run_name.description: A descriptive name for this analysis run

taxon.description: A valid taxonomic identifier (e.g. 'Mammalia') to perform in-depth analysis to get the species coverage using ete

interactive.description: Launch the Streamlit results dashboard (port 8501) after the run completes

mask.description: Mask amplicons to simulate sequencing reads of --read_length (paired-end keeps both ends, --single_end truncates)

read_length.description: Expected read length (default 400 for single end, 150 otherwise)

custom_db.description: One or more custom nucleotide FASTA databases (.fasta, .fa, .fna) - a single file, a comma-separated list, or a glob

cluster_id.description: VSEARCH --cluster_fast identity threshold used to group barcode sequences (set with --cluster_id)

dereplicate_amplicons.description: Dereplicate identical post-PCR amplicons before VSEARCH clustering

consensus_fraction.description: Minimum fraction of taxonomically assigned accessions in a cluster that must support a consensus assignment

db_filter_pattern.description: Regex pattern for removing unwanted headers from selected databases

db_filter_min_length.description: Minimum sequence length for database filtering

db_filter_max_length.description: Maximum sequence length for database filtering; no upper limit if not set

db_filter_max_n.description: Maximum number of IUPAC ambiguity bases allowed per sequence; not applied if not set

obipcr_mismatches.description: Number of mismatches allowed for obipcr

primer_site_not_found_mismatches.description: Primer-site diagnostic: maximum mismatches for a recognizable site; a candidate with more mismatches is classified PRIMER_SITE_NOT_FOUND
primer_site_not_found_mismatches.help_text: This threshold is independent of --obipcr_mismatches and must be greater than or equal to it. With the defaults, 0-2 mismatches is BOUND, 3-4 is MISMATCH, and 5 or more is PRIMER_SITE_NOT_FOUND.

primer_site_window.description: Primer-site diagnostic: bases searched on each side of the primer site predicted from the BLAST hit
primer_site_window.help_text: The predicted site is a guess when BLAST did not align the end of the barcode, because the record's unaligned part can be longer or shorter than the centroid's. In ITS2 the real site was up to 25 bp away, so the default searches 100 bp on each side.

obipcr_fixed_3prime.description: Number of 3'-terminal bases of each primer that must match without mismatch, as in a real PCR. Applied by appending '#' to those bases in the obipcr primer. 0 disables the clamp

obipcr_circular.description: Treat database records as circular in obipcr (--circular), so amplicons crossing the start/end of a complete organelle genome are found
obipcr_circular.help_text: Complete chloroplast and mitochondrial genomes are circular, but GenBank stores them as a linear string cut at an arbitrary point. An amplicon that crosses that cut is missed in linear mode. The option applies to every record in the database, including linear ones such as nuclear markers and partial gene sequences. For those, obipcr can join the end of the record to its start and report an amplicon that does not exist. This happens only when one primer site lies near the end of the record and the other near its start, within --max-length.

filter_collapsed_primers.description: Re-check obipcr amplicons against the original, uncollapsed primers and discard those only the combined degenerate primer could explain
filter_collapsed_primers.help_text: Primer FASTA input combines all forward primer variants into one IUPAC-degenerate forward primer and all reverse variants into one reverse primer. The combined primer also matches base combinations that no real primer has, so those amplicons are false positives. This filter keeps an amplicon only when both binding sites can be explained by at least one original primer, using the same mismatch budget as obipcr. Applies only when --input is a primer FASTA or a directory of them; it has no effect for a samplesheet or for --primer_set

db_filter.description: Apply header and sequence filtering to every selected database
